title: Portfolio Performance Quote Price Leaderboard
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), recurring-subscription and bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=portfolio:quote price_usd=*
| stats sum(price_usd) as total_value, avg(price_usd) as avg_value by ticker
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks ticker values by total and average price across Portfolio Performance quote events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `price_usd` values for each Portfolio Performance quote event and review total and average price by ticker.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total price.
grandmaExplanation: It will remind which ticker shows the biggest price numbers in your Portfolio Performance quote data.
